auth.loginIntro: To **book a shipment** or **get a quote** through the live ACOCAM system, please sign in to your account first:
auth.loginCombined: Log in or create an account
auth.quoteOnline: Get a quote on the website
auth.loginReturn: After you sign in on the website, return to chat and tap **Get a quote** again — your session will be detected automatically.
auth.loginTokenHint: If your website passes a customer login token to the chat widget, I can submit the quotation API on your behalf.
auth.accountGuideIntro: To **create your ACOCAM customer account** (quotes, bookings, tracking, and documents):
auth.accountStep1: 1. Go to [Log in / Create account]({{loginUrl}}) on acocamtrading.ca
auth.accountStep2: 2. Choose **Create account** / **Sign up** and complete your profile (name, email, phone).
auth.accountStep3: 3. Sign in after registration (verify your email if prompted).
auth.accountStep4: 4. Return to this chat — your session may be detected automatically if the website links the widget to your login.
auth.accountGuest: Prefer not to register yet? [Get a quote online]({{quoteUrl}}) as a guest — our team will follow up by email.
tool.trackAuthRequired: Sign-in is required to look up shipment{{tracking}} in the live system.

tool.trackError: I could not look up that shipment right now{{detail}}. Please confirm the tracking / file number, try [Track Now](https://acocamtrading.ca/), or ask to speak with a human agent.

tool.trackHelp: Need more help? Ask me another question or talk to a human agent.
